name: Hinata
source:
An international student newly arrived from Japan. On his very first day, he got conned and lost the place where he was supposed to live in. The following morning, it appears that he was not enrolled at the university. However, contrary to his appearance, this unlucky boy is very tough and got ready to face his fate…!

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=912279494]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
